title: Nearest Open Restaurants & Food Ordering Apps Scraper

location.title: Location / Address
location.description: Address, city, neighborhood, or landmark to search around (e.g., 'Times Square, New York', 'Indiranagar, Bangalore', 'SoHo, London').

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Optional exact GPS latitude. If provided with longitude, takes precedence over text location.

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Optional exact GPS longitude. If provided with latitude, takes precedence over text location.

only_open.title: Only Open Restaurants
only_open.description: If enabled, only currently open restaurants accepting orders will be returned.

max_restaurants.title: Max Restaurants
max_restaurants.description: Maximum number of nearest restaurants to retrieve.

detect_ordering_apps.title: Detect Supported Food Ordering Apps
detect_ordering_apps.description: Detect which food ordering platforms (Uber Eats, DoorDash, Grubhub, Postmates, Swiggy, Seamless, etc.) the restaurant is available on, and retrieve direct order links.

search_query.title: Food / Cuisine Query (Optional)
search_query.description: Optional search term to filter by cuisine or dish (e.g. 'pizza', 'burger', 'sushi', 'indian').
